title: A decade-scale audit of microbiome AI-readiness
problem_type: Meta-research audit of public human microbiome data/metadata reusability for AI (systematic PRISMA-guided review with tiering framework)
real_world_setting: Published human microbiome studies 2012-2025 and their repository deposits
datasets: 23,781 papers screened; 2,896 studies scored into BHAM tiers; ~720,097 samples
statistical_tests_used: Multinomial logistic regression; binary logistic regression on publication year; Holm correction
real_world_or_deployment_evidence: no (policy recommendation; standalone tier-checking tool released)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~2470 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Provides the first decade-long, sample-level audit quantifying how little human microbiome sequence data is reusable for cross-cohort AI, with a tiered metadata standard.
evaluation_metrics: Proportion of studies/samples per reusability tier; odds ratios / relative risk ratios over time

title: Integrative host-microbiome modeling uncovers the implication of oral-gut translocation in advanced cirrhosis
problem_type: Genome-scale metabolic modeling (reactobiome profiling, community FBA/FVA, host models) of paired oral-gut metagenomes
real_world_setting: Liver cirrhosis patients across severity (MELD) groups
datasets: GLA cohort (ENA PRJEB52891), RIFSYS cohort (PRJEB38481), healthy controls (PRJEB38483); independent TIPS cohort for validation; sample sizes in Supplement (UNVERIFIED)
n_cohorts_or_datasets: 2 (minimum: discovery + independent TIPS cohort; exact count UNVERIFIED)
statistical_tests_used: Kruskal-Wallis; pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum; linear regression (R2)
robustness_or_cross_dataset_test: yes (translocating species re-detected in independent cohort)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~1926 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Moves oral-gut translocation in cirrhosis from taxonomy to predicted metabolic function, linking translocating species to ammonia production via metabolic modeling.
evaluation_metrics: Oral-gut metabolic distance (Bray-Curtis on reactobiome), predicted metabolite fluxes, association with MELD

title: Nationwide profiling of vaginal microbiota in Chinese women reveals age-dependent shifts and predictive biomarkers for reproductive health
problem_type: Population-scale microbiome-host factor association and derivation of a microbiome health (balance) score
real_world_setting: 6,423 reproductive-age women from 18 Chinese provinces, with longitudinal follow-up
datasets: CALM2004 cohort (GSA-human HRA010936, n=6,423); 13 external vaginal microbiome case-control studies for score extrapolation
statistical_tests_used: PERMANOVA; linear and logistic regression; generalized additive model; sliding-window t-test; FDR correction
robustness_or_cross_dataset_test: yes (balance score extrapolated to 13 external datasets)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~2086 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Largest East Asian vaginal microbiome survey, revealing an age-40 transition and a balance score that predicts later reproductive-tract outcomes.
evaluation_metrics: Variance explained (R2), FDR-adjusted associations, balance-score group differences, associations with follow-up outcomes

title: PSOSP uncovers pervasive SOS-independent prophages with distinct genomic and host traits in bacterial genomes
problem_type: Bioinformatics tool: prediction of prophage induction mode (SOS-dependent vs independent) from LexA binding heterology index
real_world_setting: Bacterial genomes from public databases; wet-lab induction validation
datasets: 49,333 complete bacterial genomes (RefSeq-derived); E. coli LexA binding reference set (n=24); experimental test set (n=10 prophages)
n_cohorts_or_datasets: 3 (reference binding set, test set, genome survey)
statistical_tests_used: 95% confidence interval for accuracy; group comparisons with p-values (test named in Supplement; UNVERIFIED)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~2083 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Introduces a tool that classifies prophage induction modes and shows SOS-independent prophages are widespread with distinct genomic traits.

title: RepliChrom: Interpretable machine learning predicts cancer-associated enhancer-promoter interactions using DNA replication timing
problem_type: Interpretable ML (random forest) predicting enhancer-promoter interactions from DNA replication timing
real_world_setting: Human cell lines incl. leukemia; multiple chromatin-interaction technologies
datasets: Hi-C, Hi-TrAC, ChIA-PET, 5C and replication-timing data across six cell lines (+ general model); Zenodo 11398547

main_text_word_count_estimate: ~1971 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Shows replication timing alone can predict enhancer-promoter interactions with interpretable features, revealing leukemia-specific loops.

claimed_novelty: Builds a global quorum-sensing communication map and online platform for WWTP microbiomes.

real_world_setting: Human pancreatic islets across nondiabetic, prediabetic and type 2 diabetes donors

title: Gut microbiota-mediated immune and metabolic dysregulation in coronary artery disease progression and prognosis

real_world_setting: Coronary artery disease patients (PUMCH-CAD cohort), median 1.85-year follow-up for MACE

title: FluNexus: A versatile web platform for antigenic prediction and visualization of influenza A viruses

statistical_tests_used: NA in main text
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~1986 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Unifies preprocessing, ten antigenic predictors with a benchmark, and improved antigenic maps in one online platform.

title: Majorbio Cloud 2026 provides comprehensive analysis workflows for microbiome

title: Spaceflight redefines ageing-associated microbiota
problem_type: Integrative re-analysis of public scRNA-seq and multi-site metagenome/metatranscriptome data plus Mendelian randomization
real_world_setting: Astronauts before/after spaceflight vs. natural ageing cohort
datasets: PBMC scRNA-seq (ageing cohort, astronauts); gut/oral/skin metagenomes at six flight time points; sizes in Supplement (UNVERIFIED)
n_cohorts_or_datasets: 2 (minimum: ageing cohort + astronaut cohort; data from multiple databases, UNVERIFIED)
statistical_tests_used: Differential expression/abundance testing, Mendelian randomization (details in Supplement)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~2410 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)

title: A universal oral microbiome-based signature for periodontitis
jats_article_type: article-commentary (Letter-format layout; PubMed type Journal Article)
problem_type: Cross-cohort meta-analysis and ML diagnostic signature (random forest) from public shotgun metagenomes
real_world_setting: Periodontitis vs healthy, oral microbiome, 5 countries / 3 continents
datasets: 8 public oral shotgun cohorts (e.g., PRJDB11203, PRJNA230363, PRJNA396840, PRJNA678453): 6 case-control (117 cases, 106 controls) + 2 case-only (118 cases)
n_baselines_compared: 0 (single RF; taxonomic vs functional vs combined feature sets compared)
statistical_tests_used: Spearman correlation; consistency of biomarkers across >=3 cohorts; sample-cumulation modeling
robustness_or_cross_dataset_test: yes (cohort-to-cohort matrix, LODO, 2 case-only external cohorts)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~2017 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Identifies cross-cohort consistent species/pathway biomarkers and a generalizable metagenomic classifier for periodontitis.
evaluation_metrics: AUC (internal, external, LODO), true positive rate

title: Two stable gut microbiome guilds predict liver tumor class and treatment responses
problem_type: Genome-guild (co-abundance network) biomarker model + random forest classification/prediction
real_world_setting: Liver tumors (HCC, iCCA, CRLM, benign); recurrence and anti-PD-1/TACE response
datasets: Cohort 1: 120 HCC + 76 benign (PRJNA1372073/PRJNA1372070); Cohort 2: 33 HCC vs 7 CRLM; external cohort: 76 CTR, 25 HCC, 19 iCCA; treatment cohorts from Xin et al. and Zhao et al.
statistical_tests_used: PERMANOVA; Mann-Whitney U with Benjamini-Hochberg; Procrustes analysis
robustness_or_cross_dataset_test: yes (external cohort; transfer across tumor types)
main_text_word_count_estimate: ~7254 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
claimed_novelty: Uses stable competing genome guilds instead of taxa to obtain transferable gut microbiome signatures for liver tumor class and treatment outcome.

title: Linking dietary fiber to human malady through cumulative profiling of microbiota disturbance

real_world_setting: Dietary fibers, gut microbiota disturbance and human diseases

main_text_word_count_estimate: ~8257 (approximate; JATS body text excl. captions/back matter)
